title: Dot product
purpose: Multiply two vectors, materialize the products, then sum them.

title: Sum of squared errors
purpose: Materialize absolute differences, then sum their squares.

title: Thresholded signal accumulation
purpose: Combine two channels, then accumulate only values above a threshold.

title: Signal energy after gain
purpose: Apply a gain and offset to two channels, then calculate the transformed energy.

title: Histogram of XOR features
purpose: Generate a byte feature from two channels, then count it into 256 histogram bins.
